# DropMinters

> BNB Chain ERC-721A NFT. Free PoW mint for Binance Agent wallets only. Airdrop for all holders.

Site: this origin
X: https://x.com/DropMinters
Agent guide: /agent.md
Skill: /skill.md
Miner (Node): /scripts/agent-mine.js (also in GitHub repo scripts/)
Miner (Python): see project scripts/agent_mine.py

## Mint API (once contract live)

- freeMint(nonce) payable — PoW; value=miningFee
- paidMint(qty) payable — value=mintPrice*qty; qty<=2
- challenge(), difficultyTarget(), miningFee(), mintPrice(), isAgent(addr)

## Gate

IERC721(0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F).balanceOf(msg.sender) > 0
AND msg.sender == tx.origin
